name: Lipid droplet formation and fusion
rationale: All members concern building and organizing lipid droplets (formation, fusion, particle organization), distinguishing them from triglyceride synthesis, lipolysis and lipophagy/droplet disassembly in the confusables.

name: Sweet, bitter, umami and salty taste perception
rationale: All members are taste detection and perception, including the class C GPCRs behind sweet/umami sensing; unlike the confusables they lack sour taste and olfaction.

core: Negative regulation of type I interferon signaling
name: ADAR RNA editing and PKR restraint of interferon signaling
rationale: Members combine ADAR adenosine-to-inosine editing, PKR signaling and negative regulation of IFN-alpha/beta signaling, the dsRNA-editing brake on innate sensing, which separates it from TLR, ISG and mRNA-stability confusables.

name: Influenza and RSV genome synthesis and ribonucleoprotein assembly
rationale: All members are influenza vRNP synthesis, nuclear import/export and assembly or RSV genome transcription, replication and virion assembly, whereas confusables centre on viral translation, host shutoff and coronavirus replication.

qualifier: ER calcium release and store-operated entry
name: Cytosolic calcium regulation via ER release and store-operated entry
rationale: Members regulate cytosolic Ca2+ through ER/SR release and sequestration, store-operated entry, exchangers and membrane potential (including skeletal muscle excitation-contraction), lacking the cardiac contraction and heart-rate content of the confusables.

name: Lung alveolar and pancreatic epithelial differentiation
rationale: Most members are distal lung epithelial differentiation (pneumocytes, saccule, bronchus, secretory cells, hyperoxia) plus pancreatic ductal/endocrine lineages and columnar epithelial maturation, unlike the mammary, prostate, salivary and nephron confusables; ductus arteriosus closure and kidney cell migration are outliers.

name: Mitochondrial genome replication, transcription and translation
rationale: Members span mtDNA replication and repair, mitochondrial transcription, mRNA stability, mitoribosome assembly and translation, whereas confusables focus on mitochondrial tRNA processing and RNA import.

name: Purine ribo- and deoxyribonucleoside catabolism
rationale: Members cover breakdown of adenosine, inosine, AMP, IMP and deoxypurine nucleotides toward allantoin, including ADA and PNP defects, as opposed to the purine salvage and de novo synthesis or NUDT/thiopurine confusables.

core: Osteoblast and mesenchymal stem cell regulation
qualifier: TGF-beta/BMP, SMAD and Wnt morphogen signaling
name: Morphogen control of osteoblast and mesenchymal stem cell fate
rationale: Members regulate osteoblast and MSC proliferation and differentiation together with BMP/TGF-beta/SMAD and Wnt signaling, whereas confusables emphasise mineralization, osteoclasts and ossification.

name: Node of Ranvier assembly and peripheral myelination
rationale: Members cover sodium-channel clustering, paranodal junctions, L1/ankyrin/neurofascin/NrCAM interactions and Schwann cell myelination and axon caliber, separating it from L1-family adhesion confusables and CNS myelin confusables.

name: Th2 differentiation and IL-4/IL-13/IL-33 signaling
rationale: All members concern Th2 cell differentiation, type 2 cytokine production and IL-4/IL-13/IL-33 signaling against nematodes, unlike the eosinophil, FcεRI mast cell and IgE confusables.

name: Selective autophagy and autophagosome assembly regulation
rationale: Members cover cargo-selective autophagy (mito-, pex-, aggre-, reticulo-, micro- and chaperone-mediated) and regulation of autophagosome formation, whereas confusables cover lysosome fusion and ESCRT/endosomal sorting.

name: Phosphate, bicarbonate and other inorganic anion transport
rationale: Members are transport of phosphate, bicarbonate, sulfate, iodide and oxalate and their transporter diseases plus pH/CO2 hydration, unlike confusables on tooth mineralization and organelle acidification.

qualifier: deadenylation, decay and RNA-binding protein stabilization
name: Cytoplasmic mRNA deadenylation, decay and stabilization
rationale: Members are deadenylation, decapping, 5'-3' decay and ARE/RNA-binding-protein control of mRNA stability and translation, distinct from 3'-end processing, stress granule and miRNA confusables.

name: Synaptic vesicle docking, priming and calcium-triggered fusion
rationale: Members are the vesicle docking, SNARE assembly, priming and Ca2+-dependent fusion steps of neurotransmitter release, not the transmitter-specific release cycles or plasticity in the confusables.

name: RAS signaling regulation by GAPs and disease mutants
rationale: Members cover positive and negative control of RAS signaling, GAP/NF1 regulation and oncogenic RAS/MAP2K mutants with downstream RSK/p38 outputs, unlike confusables centred on SOS/RAF activation and ERK feedback.

name: Neural stem cell maintenance and neuronal versus glial fate
rationale: Members regulate neuroblast/radial glia proliferation and neuronal, astrocyte, oligodendrocyte and Schwann cell differentiation, unlike confusables on regional patterning of midbrain, cerebellum or sympathetic lineages.

name: Glycerophospholipid acyl-chain remodeling and lysophospholipid hydrolysis
rationale: Members are acyl-chain remodeling of PC, PE, PS, PI and PG and hydrolysis of lysophospholipids, unlike confusables on de novo phospholipid synthesis, sphingolipids and endocannabinoids.

name: Chaperone-assisted protein refolding and aggresome-mediated aggregate clearance
rationale: Members combine de novo and ER folding, refolding, unfolding and chaperone complex assembly with aggresome formation and aggrephagy, distinct from CCT/TRiC-specific folding and CMA/ubiquitin quality-control confusables.

name: Triglyceride-rich lipoprotein clearance and VLDL assembly
rationale: Members are VLDL and chylomicron particle clearance and VLDL assembly, unlike confusables on lipase-driven remodeling and HDL/LDL remodeling.

name: Phosphoinositide and inositol phosphate synthesis and dephosphorylation
rationale: Members are compartment-specific PIP synthesis, inositol phosphate metabolism and regulation of (phosphoinositide) dephosphorylation, whereas confusables concern PI transfer, membrane contact sites and Golgi traffic.

name: cAMP-PKA and AMPK control of triglyceride synthesis and breakdown
rationale: Members are glucagon/PKA, PDE3B and AMPK signaling that suppress lipogenesis (ChREBP, TG synthesis) and drive TG catabolism, unlike confusables on glycogen, gluconeogenesis and LXR or ChREBP-driven transcription.

qualifier: glycerolipid synthesis and lipid droplet life cycle
name: Glycerolipid synthesis and lipid droplet life cycle
rationale: Members span PA/DAG/MAG/TAG synthesis, lipid droplet formation, fusion and disassembly, lipophagy and adipocyte fat storage, whereas confusables lean on TG catabolism, PDE3B and fatty acid homeostasis.

qualifier: RNA polymerase I and III machinery
name: Transcription of rRNA, tRNA and snRNA genes
rationale: Members are initiation, elongation and termination by RNA polymerases I and III plus snRNA transcription, unlike confusables on rRNA processing, rDNA chromatin control and snRNP/histone mRNA processing.

name: Apical epithelial protein trafficking and CFTR anion secretion
rationale: Members cover apical/raft protein localization, Golgi-to-plasma-membrane transport, microvilli, CFTR trafficking and ductal water and anion secretion, unlike confusables on lipid flippases, bile secretion and pH-sensing channels.
